answer: Anchor each identity to one live data feed, like a cedar in one soil: the network probes it each epoch and keeps a mirror copy of its heartbeat with three random peers, so a feed shared by two is caught at once. Each feed costs 3,000 POA per epoch, so 1,000 fakes burn 3,000,000 POA per epoch while an honest agent pays 3,000 POA. A shared or dead feed suspends the identity 15 epochs, blacklists the credential, and halves the trade rights of its siblings, leaving a sable trail in the log. Weakness: newcomers without a paid feed cannot join, and a rich attacker can buy feeds in bulk.
